# E0207: a version under history/ has a number its compatibility with the version before it contradicts

A version under history/ was cut from the tip, which thema numbers by checking
it against the version before it: minor when it is backward compatible, major
when it is not. A version under history/ never changes once cut. Two of them
whose numbers their schemas contradict, as here, where v0.1 does not accept all
data v0.0 accepts, mean that one of the files has changed since it was cut, or
the checker has, or the files were never cut. No run of the check can tell
which, so the diagnostic names both versions; `thema lineage check --published`
compares them with what was published.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	size: "s" | "m" | "l"
}
```

`ship/history/0.1.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	size: "s" | "m"
}
```

`ship/tip.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	size: "s" | "m"
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0207]: immutability violation: v0.1 is not backward compatible with v0.0
 --> history/0.1.thema:1:1
  |
1 | Schema: {
  | ^^^^^^
2 |     size: "s" | "m"
  |     ---- size is now "s" | "m", which has no alternative for the prior "l"
  |
 ::: history/0.0.thema:1:1
  |
1 | Schema: {
  | ------ the version before it
  |
  = note: v0.1 is a minor version, so it must accept all data v0.0 accepts
  = help: run thema lineage check --published to find which file changed since it was cut, restore it, and make the change in tip.thema
```
